info.name: IPPIS employee portal tests
info.description: Send the requests in order, by hand. Fill in adminUsername, adminPassword and employeeId (a TEST employee record, not a real member of staff). With `pnpm dev`, OTP codes, the invite link and the reset link are printed in the backend terminal: copy them into `otp`, `inviteToken` and `resetToken` when a request's description says so. Run the three database/employee-portal-migration*.sql files once before the first run. Requests that upload a file (EP110, EP115, EP117) need a file chosen in their Body tab.

request.description: Put the code from the backend terminal in `otp` first.
